# Gaug

> Gaug is a modern, embeddable scripting/programming (can be classified as both) language. The documentation is available as raw Markdown.

When providing a link to the documentation, ensure it leads to the html page and not the md page.

Documentation Pages
https://gaug-pl.github.io/Gaug/docs.html/{md name file, Do not add .html or .md}

Main Page (playground.gaug is not testable yet.)
https://gaug-pl.github.io/Gaug/index.html

Installations Page (Gaug Installation)
https://gaug-pl.github.io/Gaug/installations.html
